name: The Dells
description:
Farming country of the High Marks, including the Western Dells, which the Engineers treat as their own. Farm produce is its main export; rural communities resist foreign influence. Terrain die 2.

- **[[rolltable/setting-seeds-culture-table|Culture]]: Scholarly Conquest.** The [[Engineers]] have quietly colonised the land around the [[Black Dunes|black-sand dunes]] and the [[Ancient Channel|ancient channels]], extracting vast amounts of valuable materials and learning, while the native people of the Dells carry on their lives in the more fertile land around them.
- **[[rolltable/setting-seeds-resources-table|Resources]]: Much Ore, Little Land.**

name: The Black Dunes
description:
Volcanic sands, highly rich in ore, once sacred land to the [[True Church]]. The [[Engineers]] have claimed them. Terrain die 4.

On the world globe (pole 50.27°E 10°S, seam 150°E 50°S, south compression 0.5, E/W 0.55), remapped Burgas sits at about 27.4°N 10.6°W. The globe is tilted: climate follows a hot axis, not in-world latitude, and measured from that axis this area sits at a climate latitude of about 46°, much colder than its 27°N suggests. That makes it cold, at the edge of the ice belt, and moderately dry, since much of what lies within 8° is land. On the globe's overlay it reads as pale, cold steppe or moorland, partly whitened by ice. Real east now points west-north-west here, so the real Black Sea coast faces west. Physically, think of the Kamchatka Peninsula: volcanoes, glaciers and black volcanic sand, though drier.
